title: Fox interviewed all three Rendlesham witnesses

tellings.quote: only I'm the only person to have interviewed cabansag burough and penison

plain: In 1980, US airmen at RAF Woodbridge, a base in Suffolk, England, said they saw something strange in the nearby woods. The documentary filmmaker James Fox says he is the only person to have interviewed all three of the main witnesses, men he names as Cabansag, John Burroughs and Jim Penniston. Fox tells Michels this himself, "I'm the only person to have interviewed cabansag burough and penison," and also mentions Charles Halt, another officer tied to the case.
